title: Project Technical Support III – PSG Institute of Advanced Studies
description:
**Job Description:** Project Technical Support III – DHR Project – PSG Institute of Advanced Studies

**Employment Type**: Full-time

**Location**: Coimbatore  
**Industry:** Education

**Qualification**: M.Sc. in Biotechnology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, or any other relevant Life Sciences discipline.

**Experience:** 0 - 5 years

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a Project Technical Support III professional to support research activities involving microbial isolation and identification, antimicrobial resistance profiling, biofilm studies, anti-infective coating development, biocompatibility evaluation, and gene expression analysis. The candidate will be responsible for conducting microbiological and molecular biology experiments, fabricating and characterizing coatings, evaluating their stability and efficacy, analyzing experimental results, and maintaining accurate research records in accordance with established laboratory protocols and biosafety standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

· Perform microbial isolation, identification, antimicrobial resistance (AMR) profiling, and biofilm studies.

· Develop, fabricate, and characterize anti-infective coatings using appropriate material characterization techniques.

· Evaluate coating stability, biocompatibility, antibiofilm activity, and antivirulence efficacy through microbiological and cell culture assays.

· Conduct molecular biology experiments, including DNA extraction, RNA isolation, and quantitative PCR (qPCR), for gene expression studies.

· Analyze experimental data, interpret research findings, and prepare technical reports and research documentation.

· Maintain accurate laboratory records, experimental data, and equipment logs in accordance with established protocols.

· Ensure compliance with laboratory safety, pathogen biosafety, and procedures for the handling, storage, and disposal of biological samples and laboratory waste.

· Coordinate with the research team to support experimental planning, project execution, and timely completion of research activities.

· Assist in other research and laboratory activities assigned by the Principal Investigator or Reporting Officer.

**Desired Candidates Qualifications**

· M.Sc. in Biotechnology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, or any other relevant Life Sciences discipline, with a good academic record.

· Relevant research or laboratory experience in microbiology, molecular biology, biomaterials, or related fields will be an advantage.

· Hands-on knowledge of microbial handling, pathogen biosafety, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, and biofilm assays.

· Practical knowledge of DNA extraction, RNA isolation, qPCR, and gene expression analysis.

· Understanding of anti-infective coating development, fabrication, material characterization, stability evaluation, and biocompatibility testing.

· Familiarity with cell culture techniques, antibiofilm assays, and antivirulence studies.

· Ability to analyze experimental data, interpret results, and maintain accurate technical documentation.

· Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively while adhering to laboratory safety protocols and research standards.

**About the Institution:**

PSG Institute of Advanced Studies (PSGIAS) was established with a vision to promote world-class education, research, and innovation. Functioning under the aegis of the PSG & Sons’ Charities Trust, PSGIAS serves as a bridge between global academic institutions and PSG institutions, facilitating international education and collaborative research.

At PSGIAS, we believe in nurturing intellectual curiosity and providing students with opportunities to pursue cutting-edge research and advanced learning. Our institute offers pathways to postgraduate and doctoral programs in collaboration with renowned universities across the globe, especially in countries like the USA, UK, Germany, and Australia.

title: Quality Systems Admin
company: Powersonic Electric Solution India Private Limited
description:
About the job

**Powersonic – Join Us in Powering the Future!**

Our mission at Powersonic is to help power the products of the future and make everyone fall in love with great hardware, great engineering, and great design. This mission is super exciting, but there’s still a lot to do — and that’s exactly where you come in!

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, on-site role as a **Quality System Admin** in **Coimbatore**.

You will be responsible for providing essential administrative and documentation support to the Quality team, ensuring the effective maintenance of the Quality Management System (QMS), supporting internal and external audits, maintaining quality records, coordinating training activities, and assisting with continuous improvement initiatives.

**You will: Documentation Management**

* Manage and maintain QMS documents, including revision control, distribution, and record retention.
* Ensure quality documents are updated accurately and within the required timelines.
* Review and maintain technical documents, quality manuals, work instructions, and customer specifications.
* Support the Quality team in preparing visual aids, quality check points, quality alerts, and other quality-related documents.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation for quality issues, rejects, corrective actions, and related records.
* Maintain organized physical and digital filing systems for quality documentation.
* Maintain quality records and relevant data in ERP systems, including Visual ERP.

**Audit Preparation & Support**

* Coordinate and support internal and external audits, including **ISO 9001, UL, and CSA** audits.
* Prepare and organize required documentation and records for audits and inspections.
* Support follow-up activities related to audit findings and corrective actions.
* Maintain audit schedules, records, and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure timely closure of audit-related actions.

**Data Collection & Reporting**

* Collect and maintain quality-related data accurately.
* Assist in preparing quality reports, charts, and management review reports.
* Track and maintain quality KPIs and performance indicators.
* Support data analysis and reporting for quality improvement activities.
* Ensure timely and accurate submission of quality information to management.

**Training Coordination**

* Support the coordination of quality-related training programs.
* Maintain employee training records and ensure required documentation is complete.
* Prepare and distribute training materials.
* Coordinate training schedules and maintain attendance records.
* Support compliance with quality-related training requirements.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Participate in quality improvement and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support root cause analysis and corrective action activities.
* Assist in implementing process improvements and monitoring their effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to improve quality documentation, processes, and administrative workflows.

**Coordinate with:**

* Global Quality Assurance Administrator to support quality system requirements and activities.
* Quality team members to maintain documentation, records, and quality processes.
* Production, Engineering, Purchasing, and Operations teams regarding quality requirements and documentation.
* Internal and external auditors during audit preparation and follow-up activities.
* Employees and department representatives for quality-related training and documentation.
* Management for quality reporting, KPIs, and continuous improvement activities.

**You have:**

* Strong organizational and administrative skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Good understanding of **Quality Management Systems (QMS)** and quality documentation.
* Familiarity with **ISO 9001:2015** requirements.
* Ability to read and understand technical drawings, work instructions, and manufacturing documentation.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly **Excel and Word**.
* Basic understanding of ERP systems; **Visual ERP** knowledge is preferred.
* Good data collection, documentation, and reporting skills.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and maintain accurate records.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* Exposure to a manufacturing environment.
* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in **Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, Business Administration, or a related field**.
* **1–3 years of relevant experience** in quality administration, documentation, quality coordination, or a similar manufacturing environment.

**Extra points if you also:**

* Have experience supporting **ISO 9001, UL, or CSA audits**.
* Have knowledge of **IPC standards** or other manufacturing quality standards.
* Have experience with quality documentation and document control systems.
* Have experience maintaining quality records in an ERP system.
* Have experience working with technical drawings and manufacturing processes.
* Have experience in **wiring harness, cable assembly, electrical, or electronics manufacturing**.
* Have exposure to corrective action, root cause analysis, or continuous improvement activities.
* Have a **Six Sigma Green Belt** or other quality-related certification.

**Why you'll love working with us:**

* Work with a global and multicultural Quality team.
* Gain hands-on exposure to international quality standards and QMS processes.
* Build practical experience in audits, documentation, compliance, and quality reporting.
* Work closely with Production, Engineering, Purchasing, and other cross-functional teams.
* Contribute to continuous improvement and process enhancement initiatives.
* Grow your career in a collaborative, quality-driven, and manufacturing-focused environment.
